metadata.description: Agentic AI — four plugins for Claude Code: persistent memory (Cortex, ported to TS), codebase intelligence (Rust binary kept as subprocess), genius reasoning (zetetic team), and PRD generation. All four share one install / one update path.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Persistent memory for Claude Code — TS port of Cortex. Thermodynamic heat/decay, intent-aware retrieval, biological plasticity, codebase intelligence integration. SQLite by default; PostgreSQL + pgvector when DATABASE_URL is set. 41 published papers as sources. 0.1.2: fix static-dir 4-step fallback (deployed install returned 404 on /); fix parseTags TypeError on PG JSONB arrays (facets endpoint returned {error:TypeError}).

plugins.name: codebase
plugins.description: Codebase intelligence — Full TypeScript port of automatised-pipeline 0.0.9. Indexes Rust/Python/TypeScript/JavaScript into a PostgreSQL code-intelligence graph (shared cortex_agentic DB). Resolves imports + call chains, Louvain+C2 community detection, BFS process tracing, hybrid PG-FTS+TF-IDF+RRF search. 23 MCP tools. No Rust binary required — pure Node.js.

plugins.name: reasoning
plugins.description: 97 genius reasoning patterns from history's greatest minds + 19 team specialist agents under one zetetic epistemic standard. 61 skills, 25 commands, 16 lifecycle hooks.

plugins.name: prd
plugins.description: Stateless reducer that turns a feature description into a 9-file PRD. Multi-judge verification with weighted-average + Bayesian consensus, calibrated against externally-grounded oracles (schema/math/code/spec). Phase 4 closed loop: per-judge Bayesian reliability calibration, Kaplan-Meier retry budgets, Clopper-Pearson KPI gates.
